a55719e0d237514ec1b8f9528551760be5343f64.sourceText: 当前通过这项结果广播 `odom → base_footprint`。当底盘静止、只有实际 yaw 转动时，正确的雷达位姿和机械相对 yaw 应能互相抵消，得到基本不动的底盘位姿；这是待验证的转换目标，本轮未进行该项测试。
a55719e0d237514ec1b8f9528551760be5343f64.translatedText: Currently broadcast through this result `odom → base_footprint`\. When the chassis is stationary and only the actual yaw rotation occurs, the correct radar pose and the mechanical relative yaw should cancel each other out, resulting in a chassis pose that remains essentially stationary; this is the transformation target to be verified, and this test was not conducted in this round\.

a56565e5668dc2f253c30bbff9ef4c9ba080ec1b.sourceText: 取位姿时只保留x、y和yaw。位置以m表达，yaw以rad表达；上坡时的高度、roll和pitch没有进入二维建图位姿。[二维位姿读取实现（2.6.10）](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/include/slam_toolbox/get_pose_helper.hpp)
a56565e5668dc2f253c30bbff9ef4c9ba080ec1b.translatedText: When obtaining the pose, only x, y, and yaw are retained\. Position is expressed in m, and yaw is expressed in rad; the altitude, roll, and pitch when going uphill do not enter the 2D mapping pose\.[2D pose reading implementation (2\.6\.10)](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/include/slam_toolbox/get_pose_helper.hpp)
